app.title: JusticeNow
app.tagline: Report a human rights concern safely and anonymously.

common.comingSoon: This page is coming in the next sprint.

home.privacyNote: No account is needed to use JusticeNow. We never ask for your name, phone number, or email. You will receive a secure reference code to check your case status later.

report.title: Report a case
report.privacyReassurance: We never ask for your name. Nothing on this form identifies you.
report.privacyNoteCaseType: We never ask for your name, phone or email.
report.privacyNoteDistrict: We only ask for your district, never your address.
report.privacyNoteEvidence: Only legal aid staff can open what you attach.
report.caseType: What kind of incident is this?
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what happened. Do not include your own name or contact details.
report.descriptionPrivacyHint: Tip: leave out anything that could identify you.
report.evidenceHint: A photo or document, if you have one. The filename is discarded on upload.

errors.submitFailed: Could not submit the report. Please check your connection and try again.

success.title: Your report has been received
success.writeItDown: Write this code down or take a screenshot now.
success.explanation: This code is the ONLY way to check on your case later. We cannot recover it for you, because we do not know who you are.

status.title: Check case status
status.inputHint: The code on the slip you received when you submitted your report.
status.errorNotFound: That code didn't match. Check it and try again.
status.errorNetwork: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
status.noUpdates: No public updates yet. Check back soon.

nextSteps.received: Received — your report is in the queue. A legal aid officer will begin reviewing it shortly.
nextSteps.under_review: Under review — a legal aid officer is reading your report. This usually takes a few days.
nextSteps.referred: Referred — your case has been passed to a specialist organisation who can assist you. Check updates below.
nextSteps.closed: Closed — your case has been resolved or could not be taken further. See the updates below for details.

staffReports.title: Incoming reports
staffReports.loadFailed: Could not load reports. Please try again.

referenceCode.warning: This code cannot be recovered if lost. Please write it down or save it somewhere safe.
